title: Snake Classic
description: Control the serpent, gobble apples, and grow longer without slamming into borders or your own body.
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to navigate

description: Slide numbered tiles across the 4x4 grid. Merge matching numbers to reach the legendary 2048 tile.
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to Slide

title: Retro Pong
description: The arcade classic! Bounce the ball past the opponent's paddle in solo vs CPU or local 2-player battle.

title: Flappy Jet
description: Tap or hit space to flap your wings and thrust through pipes with pixel-perfect timing.
controls: Spacebar or Left Click to Flap

title: Neon Breakout
description: Smash your way through vibrant brick walls with your paddle, bounce angles, and ball velocity.
controls: Mouse or Left/Right Arrows to move paddle

title: Galaxy Invaders
description: Defend the planet against waves of descending alien squadrons with laser cannons and protective bunkers.

title: Minesweeper
description: Clear the minefield using logic deduction and number clues. Flag mines and uncover safe terrain.
controls: Right Click or Long Press to flag

title: Desert Dino Run
description: Jump over cacti and duck beneath low-flying pterodactyls across a shifting desert landscape.
controls: Down Arrow to Duck / Fast Fall

title: Block Matrix
description: Rotate and drop falling geometric tetrominoes to clear full horizontal lines and rack up high scores.

title: Connect Four
description: Drop your tokens into the 7-column vertical grid to align 4 consecutive discs before your opponent.
controls: Click or Tap column to drop disc
